Implementation Plan

Clarification mapping used for planning:
- `Q1 -> B`: add TODO/placeholder entries for the two new cache schemas now, then replace with real filenames in H5/H6.
- `Q2 -> A`: add the H1 note under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `Q3 -> A`: audit only wrappers corresponding to `validate`, `issue_pr_status`, `memory_maintenance`, `workflow-log-analysis`, `cancel_on_pr_close`.

Factual conflicts found:
- `.github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml`, `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`, and `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml` currently do not contain support-file Contents API fetch loops, so transport migration is likely not applicable there.
- No `internal-*`/`workflow-templates/ai-*` wrapper exists for `workflow-log-analysis`; only the other four counterparts exist.
- Requirement #5 asks to include two new cache schema filenames, but filenames are unknown (`Q1: B`). Plan uses explicit TODO placeholders (non-breaking) and flags follow-up.

Implementation checklist:
- [ ] Migrate support-file fetch transport in `.github/workflows/validate.yml` from Contents API loops to the H1 checkout/staging pattern, preserving existing gates and file destinations.
- [ ] Migrate support-file fetch transport in `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` (including tg helper fetch sites) to the same H1 pattern, preserving behavior and fallbacks.
- [ ] Add TODO placeholder entries for the two future cache schemas in staged schema lists (where schema staging is performed in-scope), without introducing runtime breakage.
- [ ] Audit `.github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml`, `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`, `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`; leave unchanged if no support-fetch pattern exists.
- [ ] Audit corresponding internal/template wrappers; update only if alignment is required by changed reusable workflow wiring; otherwise keep untouched and document audit result.
- [ ] Add one H1 changelog entry under `## [Unreleased]`.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/validate.yml`
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- Possible (only if alignment required after audit):  
  `.github/workflows/internal-validate.yml`, `.github/workflows/internal-issue-pr-status.yml`, `.github/workflows/internal-memory-maintenance.yml`, `.github/workflows/internal-cancel-on-pr-close.yml`, `workflow-templates/ai-validate.yml`, `workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml`, `workflow-templates/ai-memory-maintenance.yml`, `workflow-templates/ai-cancel-on-pr-close.yml`
- Expected audit-only/no-change: `.github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml`, `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`, `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Replace shell logic inside:
  - `validate.yml` step: `Fetch workflow support files`
  - `issue_pr_status.yml` step: `Fetch memory helper scripts`
  - `issue_pr_status.yml` inline tg helper fetch blocks (merged alert + TG cleanup paths)
- Introduce/align to H1 pattern elements in those steps:
  - `SCRIPT_REF` resolution (self-repo SHA vs stable)
  - checkout-based transport into staging area
  - `${SCRIPT_REF} -> main` fallback semantics
  - copy-to-target with exact on-disk parity and chmod behavior retained

3. Data structures affected
- Support-file manifest arrays (`_fetched_scripts` and related staging/copy lists)
- Schema filename lists used for `ai-memory/schemas` staging (add two TODO placeholders per `Q1: B`)
- Runtime env vars for ref/source/staging paths used by fetch steps

4. API/interface changes
- No user-facing API/CLI/env var contract changes intended.
- No identifier renames/removals.
- Behavior goal: transport-only swap; outputs, labels, fallback behavior, and artifact paths stay bit-identical.

5. Potential risks/edge cases
- Missing files on `SCRIPT_REF` must still fallback to `main` exactly as in H1 pattern.
- Must preserve “no-work” gate behavior to avoid extra clone/fetch cost.
- Must keep executable bits and destination paths identical.
- Placeholder schema entries must not cause hard failures or noisy behavior regressions.
- `issue_pr_status.yml` currently mixes `wf_source` forms; migration must avoid changing observable repo-targeting behavior unintentionally.

6. Testing considerations
- Run YAML/schema checks: `yamllint`, `actionlint`.
- Diff-verify transport-only changes in touched workflows (no unrelated logic drift).
- Validate parity paths exist after fetch stage in both modes:
  - self repo (`script_ref=github.sha`)
  - external consumer (`script_ref=stable`, fallback to `main`).
- Confirm existing gate paths still short-circuit unchanged.
- Confirm wrappers/templates either unchanged (with audit note) or only minimally updated for alignment.
- Confirm changelog entry is under `## [Unreleased]` only.
